brief_summary: The clinical study determines the safety and efficacy of Sitagliptin (MK0431) in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus who have inadequate glycemic control on diet/exercise therapy.
brief_title: A Study of Sitagliptin in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Who Have Inadequate Glycemic Control on Diet/Exercise Therapy (0431-054)(COMPLETED)

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients have type 2 diabetes mellitus on diet/exercise therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients have type 1 diabetes mellitus

official_title: Sitagliptin (MK0431) Phase III Double-blind Comparative Study - Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus -

primary_outcomes.measure: Change From Baseline in HbA1c at Week 12
